√klid 'be wet'
present: [4.] klidyati klidyate etc. E.+ -- [1.] klindant 
[perfect: cikleda aklidat klediṣyati kletsyati kleditā klettā ]
verbal: klinna S.+ kliditvā klittvā 
secondary: intensive: ceklid- -- desiderative: ciklediṣa- ciklidiṣa- ciklitsa- -- causative: kledayati etc. S.+ 
derivatives: -klíndu kleda E.+ -kledin C. -kledya E. kledana C. -kledīyas AV.

√kliś 'distress'
present: [9.] kliśnāti etc. E.+ -- [4.] kliśyate etc. E.+ kliśyati etc. E.+ 
perfect: cikleśa etc. 
[aorist: kliśyāt akleśi acikliśat akleśīt aklikṣat kleśiṣyati klekṣyati kleśitā kleṣṭā ]
verbal: kliṣṭa E.+ kliśita kleṣṭum kliśitvā kliṣṭvā -klíśya ŚB.+ 
secondary: intensive: cekliś- -- desiderative: cikleśiṣa- cikliśiṣa- ciklikṣa- -- causative: kleśayati etc. E.+ 
derivatives: kleśa U.+ -kleśaka C. kleśin C. kleśana C. kleṣṭṛ E.
